     149             : // Non-RAII API for manipulating the thread-local dispatch state.
     150             : // Please prefer the RAII API.  The non-RAII API may be useful when
     151             : // the included/excluded state of a given DispatchKey must span
     152             : // many calls from the Python to the C++, so you cannot conveniently

     155             : // Example use case:  a Python context manager that includes a certain
